verses.ar: «وَلَكِنِ ٱسْمَعِ ٱلْآنَ يَا أَيُّوبُ أَقْوَالِي، وَٱصْغَ إِلَى كُلِّ كَلَامِي.
verses.kjv: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.
verses.web: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.
verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם שְׁמַֽע־נָ֣א אִיֹּ֣וב מִלָּ֑י וְֽכָל־דְּבָרַ֥י הַאֲזִֽינָה׃

verses.ar: هَأَنَذَا قَدْ فَتَحْتُ فَمِي. لِسَانِي نَطَقَ فِي حَنَكِي.
verses.kjv: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.
verses.web: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
verses.he: הִנֵּה־נָ֭א פָּתַ֣חְתִּי פִ֑י דִּבְּרָ֖ה לְשֹׁונִ֣י בְחִכִּֽי׃

verses.ar: اِسْتِقَامَةُ قَلْبِي كَلَامِي، وَمَعْرِفَةُ شَفَتَيَّ هُمَا تَنْطِقَانِ بِهَا خَالِصَةً.
verses.kjv: My words [shall be of] the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.
verses.web: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
verses.he: יֹֽשֶׁר־לִבִּ֥י אֲמָרָ֑י וְדַ֥עַת שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י בָּר֥וּר מִלֵּֽלוּ׃

verses.ar: رُوحُ ٱللهِ صَنَعَنِي وَنَسَمَةُ ٱلْقَدِيرِ أَحْيَتْنِي.
verses.kjv: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
verses.web: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.
verses.he: רֽוּחַ־אֵ֥ל עָשָׂ֑תְנִי וְנִשְׁמַ֖ת שַׁדַּ֣י תְּחַיֵּֽנִי׃

verses.ar: إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ فَأَجِبْنِي. أَحْسِنِ ٱلدَّعْوَى أَمَامِي. اِنْتَصِبْ.
verses.kjv: If thou canst answer me, set [thy words] in order before me, stand up.
verses.web: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
verses.he: אִם־תּוּכַ֥ל הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי עֶרְכָ֥ה לְ֝פָנַ֗י הִתְיַצָּֽבָה׃

verses.ar: هَأَنَذَا حَسَبَ قَوْلِكَ عِوَضًا عَنِ ٱللهِ. أَنَا أَيْضًا مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ تَقَرَّصْتُ.
verses.kjv: Behold, I [am] according to thy wish in God’s stead: I also am formed out of the clay.
verses.web: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.
verses.he: הֵן־אֲנִ֣י כְפִ֣יךָ לָאֵ֑ל מֵ֝חֹ֗מֶר קֹרַ֥צְתִּי גַם־אָֽנִי׃

verses.ar: هُوَذَا هَيْبَتِي لَا تُرْهِبُكَ وَجَلَالِي لَا يَثْقُلُ عَلَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.
verses.web: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.
verses.he: הִנֵּ֣ה אֵ֭מָתִי לֹ֣א תְבַעֲתֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝אַכְפִּ֗י עָלֶ֥יךָ לֹא־יִכְבָּֽד׃

verses.ar: «إِنَّكَ قد قُلْتَ في مَسَامِعِي، وَصَوْتَ أَقْوَالِكَ سَمِعْتُ.
verses.kjv: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of [thy] words, [saying],
verses.web: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,
verses.he: אַ֭ךְ אָמַ֣רְתָּ בְאָזְנָ֑י וְקֹ֖ול מִלִּ֣ין אֶשְׁמָֽע׃

verses.ar: قُلْتَ: أَنَا بَرِيءٌ بِلَا ذَنْبٍ. زَكِيٌّ أَنَا وَلَا إِثْمَ لِي.
verses.kjv: I am clean without transgression, I [am] innocent; neither [is there] iniquity in me.
verses.web: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
verses.he: זַ֥ךְ אֲנִ֗י בְּֽלִ֫י פָ֥שַׁע חַ֥ף אָנֹכִ֑י וְלֹ֖א עָוֹ֣ן לִֽי׃

verses.ar: هُوَذَا يَطْلُبُ عَلَيَّ عِلَلَ عَدَاوَةٍ. يَحْسِبُنِي عَدُوًّا لَهُ.
verses.kjv: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,
verses.web: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.
verses.he: הֵ֣ן תְּ֭נוּאֹות עָלַ֣י יִמְצָ֑א יַחְשְׁבֵ֖נִי לְאֹויֵ֣ב לֹֽו׃

verses.ar: وَضَعَ رِجْلَيَّ فِي ٱلْمِقْطَرَةِ. يُرَاقِبُ كُلَّ طُرُقِي.
verses.kjv: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.
verses.web: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’
verses.he: יָשֵׂ֣ם בַּסַּ֣ד רַגְלָ֑י יִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר כָּל־אָרְחֹתָֽי׃

verses.ar: «هَا إِنَّكَ فِي هَذَا لَمْ تُصِبْ. أَنَا أُجِيبُكَ، لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ أَعْظَمُ مِنَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ.
verses.kjv: Behold, [in] this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.
verses.web: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.
verses.he: הֶן־זֹ֣את לֹא־צָדַ֣קְתָּ אֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ כִּֽי־יִרְבֶּ֥ה אֱ֝לֹ֗והַ מֵאֱנֹֽושׁ׃

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا تُخَاصِمُهُ؟ لِأَنَّ كُلَّ أُمُورِهِ لَا يُجَاوِبُ عَنْهَا.
verses.kjv: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.
verses.web: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?
verses.he: מַ֭דּוּעַ אֵלָ֣יו רִיבֹ֑ותָ כִּ֥י כָל־דְּ֝בָרָ֗יו לֹ֣א־יַעֲנֶֽה׃

verses.ar: لَكِنَّ ٱللهَ يَتَكَلَّمُ مَرَّةً، وَبِٱثْنَتَيْنِ لَا يُلَاحِظُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ.
verses.kjv: For God speaketh once, yea twice, [yet man] perceiveth it not.
verses.web: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.
verses.he: כִּֽי־בְאַחַ֥ת יְדַבֶּר־אֵ֑ל וּ֝בִשְׁתַּ֗יִם לֹ֣א יְשׁוּרֶֽנָּה׃

verses.ar: فِي حُلْمٍ فِي رُؤْيَا ٱللَّيْلِ، عِنْدَ سُقُوطِ سُبَاتٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ، فِي ٱلنُّعَاسِ عَلَى ٱلْمَضْجَعِ.
verses.kjv: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;
verses.web: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,
verses.he: בַּחֲלֹ֤ום ׀ חֶזְיֹ֬ון לַ֗יְלָה בִּנְפֹ֣ל תַּ֭רְדֵּמָה עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֑ים בִּ֝תְנוּמֹ֗ות עֲלֵ֣י מִשְׁכָּֽב׃

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ يَكْشِفُ آذَانَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَيَخْتِمُ عَلَى تَأْدِيبِهِمْ،
verses.kjv: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,
verses.web: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
verses.he: אָ֣ז יִ֭גְלֶה אֹ֣זֶן אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וּבְמֹ֖סָרָ֣ם יַחְתֹּֽם׃

verses.ar: لِيُحَوِّلَ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ عَنْ عَمَلِهِ، وَيَكْتُمَ ٱلْكِبْرِيَاءَ عَنِ ٱلرَّجُلِ،
verses.kjv: That he may withdraw man [from his] purpose, and hide pride from man.
verses.web: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.
verses.he: לְ֭הָסִיר אָדָ֣ם מַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְגֵוָ֖ה מִגֶּ֣בֶר יְכַסֶּֽה׃

verses.ar: لِيَمْنَعَ نَفْسَهُ عَنِ ٱلْحُفْرَةِ وَحَيَاتَهُ مِنَ ٱلزَّوَالِ بِحَرْبَةِ ٱلْمَوْتِ.
verses.kjv: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.web: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.
verses.he: יַחְשֹׂ֣ךְ נַ֭פְשֹׁו מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת וְ֝חַיָּתֹ֗ו מֵעֲבֹ֥ר בַּשָּֽׁלַח׃

verses.ar: أَيْضًا يُؤَدَّبُ بِٱلْوَجَعِ عَلَى مَضْجَعِهِ، وَمُخَاصَمَةُ عِظَامِهِ دَائِمَةٌ،
verses.kjv: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong [pain:]
verses.web: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
verses.he: וְהוּכַ֣ח בְּ֭מַכְאֹוב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבֹ֑ו *וְרִיב (וְרֹ֖וב) עֲצָמָ֣יו אֵתָֽן׃

verses.ar: فَتَكْرَهُ حَيَاتُهُ خُبْزًا، وَنَفْسُهُ ٱلطَّعَامَ ٱلشَّهِيَّ.
verses.kjv: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.
verses.web: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.
verses.he: וְזִֽהֲמַ֣תּוּ חַיָּתֹ֣ו לָ֑חֶם וְ֝נַפְשֹׁ֗ו מַאֲכַ֥ל תַּאֲוָֽה׃

verses.ar: فَيَبْلَى لَحْمُهُ عَنِ ٱلْعِيَانِ، وَتَنْبَرِي عِظَامُهُ فَلَا تُرَى،
verses.kjv: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones [that] were not seen stick out.
verses.web: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.
verses.he: יִ֣כֶל בְּשָׂרֹ֣ו מֵרֹ֑אִי *וּשְׁפִי (וְשֻׁפּ֥וּ) עַ֝צְמֹותָ֗יו לֹ֣א רֻאּֽוּ׃

verses.ar: وَتَقْرُبُ نَفْسُهُ إِلَى ٱلْقَبْرِ، وَحَيَاتُهُ إِلَى ٱلْمُمِيتِينَ.
verses.kjv: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.
verses.web: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.
verses.he: וַתִּקְרַ֣ב לַשַּׁ֣חַת נַפְשֹׁ֑ו וְ֝חַיָּתֹ֗ו לַֽמְמִתִֽים׃

verses.ar: إِنْ وُجِدَ عِنْدَهُ مُرْسَلٌ، وَسِيطٌ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ أَلْفٍ لِيُعْلِنَ لِلْإِنْسَانِ ٱسْتِقَامَتَهُ،
verses.kjv: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:
verses.web: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,
verses.he: אִם־יֵ֤שׁ עָלָ֨יו ׀ מַלְאָ֗ךְ מֵלִ֗יץ אֶחָ֥ד מִנִּי־אָ֑לֶף לְהַגִּ֖יד לְאָדָ֣ם יָשְׁרֹֽו׃

verses.ar: يَتَرَاَءَفُ عَلَيْهِ وَيَقُولُ: أُطْلِقُهُ عَنِ ٱلْهُبُوطِ إِلَى ٱلْحُفْرَةِ، قَدْ وَجَدْتُ فِدْيَةً.
verses.kjv: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.
verses.web: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’
verses.he: וַיְחֻנֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר פְּ֭דָעֵהוּ מֵרֶ֥דֶת שָׁ֗חַת מָצָ֥אתִי כֹֽפֶר׃

verses.ar: يَصِيرُ لَحْمُهُ أَغَضَّ مِنْ لَحْمِ ٱلصَّبِيِّ، وَيَعُودُ إِلَى أَيَّامِ شَبَابِهِ.
verses.kjv: His flesh shall be fresher than a child’s: he shall return to the days of his youth:
verses.web: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.
verses.he: רֻֽטֲפַ֣שׁ בְּשָׂרֹ֣ו מִנֹּ֑עַר יָ֝שׁ֗וּב לִימֵ֥י עֲלוּמָֽיו׃

verses.ar: يُصَلِّي إِلَى ٱللهِ فَيَرْضَى عَنْهُ، وَيُعَايِنُ وَجْهَهُ بِهُتَافٍ فَيَرُدُّ عَلَى ٱلْإِنْسَانِ بِرَّهُ.
verses.kjv: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.
verses.web: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.
verses.he: יֶעְתַּ֤ר אֶל־אֱלֹ֨והַּ ׀ וַיִּרְצֵ֗הוּ וַיַּ֣רְא פָּ֭נָיו בִּתְרוּעָ֑ה וַיָּ֥שֶׁב לֶ֝אֱנֹ֗ושׁ צִדְקָתֹֽו׃

verses.ar: يُغَنِّي بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَيَقُولُ: قَدْ أَخْطَأْتُ، وَعَوَّجْتُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ، وَلَمْ أُجَازَ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: He looketh upon men, and [if any] say, I have sinned, and perverted [that which was] right, and it profited me not;
verses.web: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
verses.he: יָשֹׁ֤ר ׀ עַל־אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָ֭טָאתִי וְיָשָׁ֥ר הֶעֱוֵ֗יתִי וְלֹא־שָׁ֥וָה לִֽי׃

verses.ar: فَدَى نَفْسِي مِنَ ٱلْعُبُورِ إِلَى ٱلْحُفْرَةِ، فَتَرَى حَيَاتِيَ ٱلنُّورَ.
verses.kjv: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.
verses.web: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’
verses.he: פָּדָ֣ה *נַפְשִׁי (נַ֭פְשֹׁו) מֵעֲבֹ֣ר בַּשָּׁ֑חַת *וְחַיָּתִי (וְ֝חַיָּתֹו) בָּאֹ֥ור תִּרְאֶֽה׃

verses.ar: «هُوَذَا كُلُّ هَذِهِ يَفْعَلُهَا ٱللهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَثَلَاثًا بِٱلْإِنْسَانِ،
verses.kjv: Lo, all these [things] worketh God oftentimes with man,
verses.web: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,
verses.he: הֶן־כָּל־אֵ֭לֶּה יִפְעַל־אֵ֑ל פַּעֲמַ֖יִם שָׁלֹ֣ושׁ עִם־גָּֽבֶר׃

verses.ar: لِيَرُدَّ نَفْسَهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُفْرَةِ، لِيَسْتَنِيرَ بِنُورِ ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ.
verses.kjv: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.web: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.
verses.he: לְהָשִׁ֣יב נַ֭פְשֹׁו מִנִּי־שָׁ֑חַת לֵ֝אֹ֗ור בְּאֹ֣ור הַֽחַיִּים׃

verses.ar: فَٱصْغَ يَا أَيُّوبُ وَٱسْتَمِعْ لِي. اُنْصُتْ فَأَنَا أَتَكَلَّمُ.
verses.kjv: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.
verses.web: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.
verses.he: הַקְשֵׁ֖ב אִיֹּ֥וב שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וְאָנֹכִ֥י אֲדַבֵּֽר׃

verses.ar: إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ كَلَامٌ فَأَجِبْنِي. تَكَلَّمْ. فَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ تَبْرِيرَكَ.
verses.kjv: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.
verses.web: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
verses.he: אִם־יֵשׁ־מִלִּ֥ין הֲשִׁיבֵ֑נִי דַּ֝בֵּ֗ר כִּֽי־חָפַ֥צְתִּי צַדְּקֶֽךָּ׃

verses.ar: وَإِلَّا فَٱسْتَمِعْ أَنْتَ لِي. اُنْصُتْ فَأُعَلِّمَكَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ».
verses.kjv: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.
verses.web: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
verses.he: אִם־אַ֭יִן אַתָּ֥ה שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י הַ֝חֲרֵ֗שׁ וַאֲאַלֶּפְךָ֥ חָכְמָֽה׃ ס
